findings.title: X-Forwarded-For Header Spoofing - Authentication Bypass
findings.description: The application uses the X-Forwarded-For HTTP header to determine if a request originates from an internal IP address (127.0.0.1 or localhost). This header is fully controlled by the client and can be spoofed to bypass authentication. When the header is set to an allowed IP, the application displays the flag without any actual credential verification.

reproduction.expected: Response contains 'Welcome Admin' and the flag
